summary: Final QA Round 2 verified. Backend: 7 new tests added in /app/backend/tests/test_final_qa_r2.py (all passing) covering (a) POST /api/auth/register echoes address_line1..country in the user payload, (b) GET /api/auth/me surfaces address fields as top-level keys (None allowed), (c) PUT /api/auth/me with X-CSRF-Token + cargoone_csrf cookie persists all six new address fields + phone, (d) PUT /api/auth/me without CSRF is rejected (403), (e) regression login/me/logout on seeded testcustomer, (f) /booking-fee-bands/preview still returns 200 with booking_fee + booking_fee_percent, (g) /payments/status/{unknown} returns 404. Full deterministic suite (test_password_reset + test_booking_fee_bands + test_booking_fees + test_payment_and_csrf_security + test_payment_finalisation + test_cookie_auth + test_final_qa_r2) = 78 passed / 0 failed (test_moderation.py has an unrelated pre-existing ImportError for services.moderation and was excluded — not caused by this sprint). Frontend E2E: (1) /contact — all 6 channel cards render on 1280 & 390 with correct href values (mailto:hello@cargoone.co.uk, tel:+448001110000, tel:+447757133163, https://wa.me/447757133163 with target=_blank, tel:+448001110999, google maps with target=_blank). (2) /admin/queues shows 28 contact rows each with contact-reply-<id> (mailto:), contact-call-<id> (tel:), contact-whatsapp-<id> (wa.me) — verified href prefixes and mailto body encoded original message. (3) /auth/register at 390px shows address fieldset, invalid postcode 'BAD-PC' surfaces the 'valid UK postcode' error and blocks submit, valid submit creates customer + lands on /customer. (4) /customer/profile shows avatar+camera upload button, Edit reveals all 7 new inputs (address1/2/town/county/postcode/country/phone), invalid postcode surfaces 'valid UK postcode' error, valid save persists and profile-address-summary renders. (5) /customer/booking/UNKNOWN?payment=success&session_id=… renders the payment-polling-fullscreen with NO 'booking is not defined' or ReferenceError overlay. Horizontal-scroll audit: sampled 37 pages × 3 breakpoints = 111 checks (17 public+customer, 8 driver, 12 admin+settings) — 0 real overflows, ignoring intentional overflow-x auto/scroll containers. document.body.scrollWidth == window.innerWidth on every sampled page.
action_items: None blocking. Optional cleanup: /app/backend/tests/test_moderation.py has ImportError 'No module named services.moderation' — unrelated to this sprint but should be fixed (add /app/backend to PYTHONPATH in pytest.ini or update the import path).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py UserBase/UserPublic/user_to_public correctly extended with the 6 new address fields; register + PUT /auth/me allow-list both include them. LGTM.

Register endpoint stores fields with no server-side postcode/phone validation — client-side helpers in frontend/src/lib/validators.js guard entry, but an API consumer could still POST malformed data. Consider mirroring the UK postcode/phone regex server-side for defence-in-depth (non-blocking).

Profile.jsx uses data-testid 'profile-edit' + 'profile-edit-save' (not 'profile-edit-btn'/'profile-save-btn' as the FINAL_QA_ROUND2_REPORT.md description suggested). No functional issue, but future testing agents relying on the report doc will trip on this. Recommend syncing the docs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all sampled flows and 111 overflow checks

test_credentials: Used seeded credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (testcustomer, testdriver, admin). TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD env var set to seeded admin secret when invoking pytest.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_qar2_* customer accounts via /auth/register (idempotent; prefixed for cleanup). Registered 1 QA R2 UI account via the browser flow. No other side-effects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Round 2 deliverables verified. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_final_qa_r2.py is the canonical regression pack for address-field contract — safe to rerun with TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD=<admin secret from memory>. Correct testIDs are: register-{name,email,password,phone,address1,address2,town,county,postcode,country}-input + register-submit-btn; profile-{photo-upload-btn,photo-input,edit,edit-save,edit-cancel,{address1,address2,town,county,postcode,country,phone,name}-input,address-summary}; contact-{reply,call,whatsapp}-<id> on admin queues; login testID is login-submit-button (NOT login-submit-btn). The FINAL_QA_ROUND2_REPORT.md doc says 'profile-photo-upload-btn' etc., which do match. Booking Detail crash fix confirmed live. test_moderation.py ImportError is pre-existing and independent of this sprint.
